responsibility: Specializes the Arm backend for uClinux targets using EABI. It sets single-PIC-base and interworking defaults, combines BPABI with Linux-style preprocessor builtins, selects the AAPCS-Linux ABI, adjusts linker specs for elf2flt and pic veneers, overrides the cacheflush syscall sequence, and sets the target2 DWARF relocation format expected by this uClinux EABI environment.
